tests.name: 1 000 rooms, one unreachable
tests.data:
import random
random.seed(8410)
n = 1000
order = list(range(1, n))
random.shuffle(order)
rooms = [[] for _ in range(n)]
prev = 0
for r in order[:-1]:
    rooms[prev].append(r)
    prev = r
for _ in range(1500):
    a = random.randrange(n)
    b = random.randrange(n)
    if b != order[-1]:
        rooms[a].append(b)
